body:
王灵官平安好运符

王灵官是道教重要护法神将，又称灵官王天君，以威猛刚正、护法驱邪著称，在道教宫观及传统信仰中具有重要地位。王灵官镇守道场、护正驱邪，历来受到广大信众敬奉。

王灵官平安好运符奉请王灵官威灵护佑，主要用于祈求护身保平安、消灾解厄、避邪护身、远离不顺，并祈求日常生活、工作及出行平安顺遂、吉祥好运。

什么人适合奉请？

本符适合所有希望祈求日常平安、生活顺遂、吉祥好运及护身避邪的善信奉请。

无论是希望平时平平安安、诸事顺利、好运相随，还是经常外出、开车、旅行或工作环境较复杂者，都适合奉请。

也适合近期诸事不顺，希望消灾解厄、转顺增吉者，以及希望为自己或家人祈求平安、吉祥、出入顺遂的善信。

由吉法新道长亲自书写并开光加持

每一道王灵官平安好运符均由美国阳翥道教协会会长吉法新道长亲自书写，并亲自依传统道教方式进行开光加持。

每道符均根据奉请人的个人资料进行准备。

购买时请附：姓名、出生年月日时及地址。

使用方法

本款为随身佩戴符，可随身佩戴或随身携带。

可妥善放置于钱包、证件夹、随身包袋或其他干净、安全的位置。奉请后应妥善保存，避免随意丢弃、污损或放置于不洁之处。

body_en:
Peace, Protection & Good Luck Talisman — Wang Lingguan

Wang Lingguan is an important Taoist guardian deity revered for protecting devotees, guarding sacred spaces, dispelling harmful influences, and upholding righteousness.

The Wang Lingguan Peace, Protection & Good Luck Talisman invokes his protection and is prepared for everyday peace, personal safety, good fortune, relief from misfortune, protection from harmful influences, and a smooth and auspicious daily life.

Who Is This Talisman Suitable For?

This talisman is suitable for anyone seeking peace, protection, good luck, and greater harmony in everyday life.

It is ideal for those who simply wish to stay safe, enjoy a peaceful daily life, and welcome good fortune, as well as people who travel frequently, drive regularly, or work in complicated environments.

It may also be requested by those experiencing a period of difficulties or misfortune, or by anyone seeking peace, safety, and good fortune for themselves or their family members.

Personally Prepared by Dpr. Zhouxinyu Ji

Each Wang Lingguan talisman is personally hand-drawn by Dpr. Zhouxinyu Ji, President of the Yangzhu Taoist Association of America, and personally consecrated and blessed according to traditional Taoist practice.

Each talisman is prepared using the information of the person requesting it.

When ordering, please provide the full name, date and time of birth, and address.

How to Use

This is a wearable talisman designed to be carried or worn.

It may be respectfully kept in a wallet, document holder, personal bag, or another clean and secure place. It should be carefully preserved and treated respectfully after it is received.
